headline: Budget Retailer Poundland Enters Administration, Threatening Jobs
summary: British budget retailer Poundland has gone into administration, leaving thousands of workers facing potential redundancy and roughly 2,000 suppliers facing major financial hits.
why: The collapse of a major high-street retail chain creates widespread supply-chain shockwaves and highlights pressures on traditional bricks-and-mortar retail margins.

impacts.name: Retail
impacts.why: Entering administration halts normal operations and threatens supplier payments across the retail network.
